content: The rockslide clears on the morning of day 5. It's currently day 1, 11:96. I need to wait until day 5 morning. Let me save this lesson and wait.

args.lesson: When the Rockslide at (11,4) blocks the path to the Old Shrine chest, wait until the morning of day 5 of spring because the repair crew clears it then; nothing can pass before day 5.
